facts.claim: The 'e-Permit' is only valid for visits to 'Gir Jungle Safari', 'GIZ Devalia Safari', 'Ambardi Safari Park', and 'Girnar Nature Safari'.
facts.subject: e_permit
facts.evidence: The 'e-Permit' is for a visit to 'Gir Jungle Safari', 'GIZ Devalia Safari', 'Ambardi Safari Park' and 'Girnar Nature Safari' only.

facts.claim: It is compulsory to carry the 'e-Permit' during reporting and entry time.
facts.subject: e_permit
facts.evidence: It is compulsory to carry the 'e-Permit' during reporting and entry time.

facts.claim: All visitors must carry their original photo identity proof (Aadhar Card/PAN Card/Driving Licence/Voter ID Card).
facts.subject: visitor
facts.evidence: All the visitors should carry their original photo identity proof (Aadhar Card/PAN Card/Driving Licence/Voter ID Card).

facts.claim: Foreigners must carry their original passport as the photo identity proof.
facts.subject: foreigner
facts.evidence: For FOREIGNER , it is compulsory to keep the original passport as the photo identity proof with him/her.

facts.claim: Entry will not be permitted for the safari without original photo identity proof.
facts.subject: entry
facts.evidence: Entry will not be permitted for the safari without original photo identity proof.

facts.claim: During the reporting time, the presence of each person is compulsory.
facts.subject: person
facts.evidence: During the reporting time, the presence of each person is compulsory.

facts.claim: One 'e-Permit' allows entry of a maximum of 6 adults + 1 child (3-12 years) to visit 'Gir Jungle Safari', 'GIZ Devalia Safari', 'Ambardi Safari Park', and 'Girnar Nature Safari' within the selected time slot on a particular route only.
facts.subject: e_permit
facts.evidence: One 'e-Permit' allows entry of a maximum of 6 adults + 1 child* (3-12 years) to visit 'Gir Jungle Safari', 'GIZ Devalia Safari', 'Ambardi Safari Park' and 'Girnar Nature Safari' within the selected time slot on a particular route only.

facts.claim: For Gir Jungle Safari and Girnar Nature Safari, one person can get only one 'e-Permit' per slot per day.
facts.subject: person
facts.evidence: For Gir Jungle Safari and Girnar Nature Safari, one person can get only one 'e-Permit' per slot per day.

facts.claim: 'GIZ Devalia Safari Park' remains closed every Wednesday.
facts.subject: giz_devalia_safari_park
facts.evidence: 'GIZ Devalia Safari Park' remain closed every Wednesday.

facts.claim: The e-permit does not include the Guide and Safari vehicle charge, which must be paid separately to respective Guides and Safari vehicle owners.
facts.subject: e_permit
facts.evidence: The e-permit doesn't includes the Guide and Safari vehicle charge,which must be paid separatley to respective Guides and Safari vehicle owners.

facts.claim: The Forest Department's concerned authorities reserve the full rights to change the time slot timings as per the weather/seasonal conditions or due to sudden, unavoidable circumstances.
facts.subject: forest_department
facts.evidence: The Forest Department's concerned authorities reserve the full rights to change the time slot timings as per the weather/seasonal conditions or due to sudden, unavoidable circumstances.

facts.claim: 'Gir Jungle Trail' and 'Girnar Nature Safari' can be booked only through the online booking system, and 'GIZ Devalia Gypsy Safari' can be booked online as well as current booking if the permits are available.
facts.subject: booking
facts.evidence: 'Gir Jungle Trail' and 'Girnar Nature Safari' can be booked only through the online booking system, and 'GIZ Devalia Gypsy Safari can be booked online as well as current booking if the permits are available.

facts.claim: For Gir Jungle Trail, GIZ Devalia Gypsy Safari, 'Ambardi Safari Park' and Girnar Nature Safari, online booking opens three months before the date and closes down two hours before the date.
facts.subject: online_booking
facts.evidence: For Gir Jungle Trail, GIZ Devalia Gypsy Safari, 'Ambardi Safari Park' and Girnar Nature Safari, online booking opens three months before the date. It closes down two hours before the date.

facts.claim: If one does not receive an e-Permit despite the successful financial transaction due to technical errors, a refund will be done in 15-20 working days.
facts.subject: e_permit
facts.evidence: If one does not receive an e-Permit despite the successful financial transaction due to technical errors, a refund will be done in 15-20 working days.

facts.claim: For such issues, kindly send an email to gslcsgir@yahoo.com or call us on 02877-285621.
facts.subject: gslcsgir
facts.evidence: For such issues, kindly send an email to gslcsgir@yahoo.com or call us on 02877-285621.

facts.claim: Gir Jungle Trail, GIZ Devalia Gypsy Safari, 'Ambardi Safari Park' and Girnar Nature Safari visitors are requested to arrive at the respective reception centres (boarding point) 30 minutes before the scheduled time mentioned in the e-Permit.
facts.subject: visitor
facts.evidence: Gir Jungle Trail, GIZ Devalia Gypsy Safari, 'Ambardi Safari Park' and Girnar Nature Safari visitors are requested to arrive at the respective reception centres (boarding point) 30 minutes before the scheduled time mentioned in the e-Permit.

facts.claim: If the late reporting at the boarding point, e-Permit will get cancelled, and no refund can be claimed.
facts.subject: e_permit
facts.evidence: If the late reporting at the boarding point, e-Permit will get cancelled, and no refund can be claimed.

facts.claim: The waitlist will be cleared only as per the cancellation.
facts.subject: waitlist
facts.evidence: The waitlist will be cleared only as per the cancellation.

facts.claim: An eco-guide will accompany the visitors during the safari, and eco-guide allocation will be done randomly by the concerned authority.
facts.subject: eco_guide
facts.evidence: An eco-guide will accompany the visitors during the safari, and eco-guide allocation will be done randomly by the concerned authority.

facts.claim: For the safari, each visitor's name, his/her identity card number and type of identity card should be mentioned during the online booking.
facts.subject: visitor
facts.evidence: For the safari, each visitor's name, his/her identity card number and type of identity card should be mentioned during the online booking

facts.claim: No other person than the registered visitor is allowed in the safari vehicle.
facts.subject: safari_vehicle
facts.evidence: No other person than the registered visitor is allowed in the safari vehicle.

facts.claim: Bookings with incomplete or incorrect I.D. proof will be considered invalid.
facts.subject: booking
facts.evidence: Bookings with incomplete or incorrect I.D. proof will be considered invalid.

facts.claim: No Gir Jungle Trail, GIZ Devalia Gypsy Safari, 'Ambardi Safari Park' and Girnar Nature Safari will be permitted against such bookings.
facts.subject: booking
facts.evidence: No Gir Jungle Trail, GIZ Devalia Gypsy Safari, 'Ambardi Safari Park' and Girnar Nature Safari will be permitted against such bookings.

facts.claim: No refund will be made for such cases.
facts.subject: booking
facts.evidence: No refund will be made for such cases.

facts.claim: All disputes and legal matters are subject to the jurisdiction of Junagadh district, Gujarat state only.
facts.subject: dispute
facts.evidence: All disputes and legal matters are subject to the jurisdiction of Junagadh district, Gujarat state only.

facts.claim: The services such as the issue of duplicate permits for lost/mutilated/torn permits and bulk booking for more than six people (for Gir Jungle Trail, GIZ Devalia Gypsy Safari and Girnar Nature Safari) will not be provided.
facts.subject: service
facts.evidence: The services such as the issue of duplicate permits for lost/mutilated/torn permits and bulk booking for more than six people (for Gir Jungle Trail, GIZ Devalia Gypsy Safari and Girnar Nature Safari) will not be provided.

facts.claim: An application for access to or collection of biological resources for commercial utilization must be accompanied with a process fee of Rs. 5000/- in the form of a demand draft.
facts.subject: application_form_i
facts.evidence: Every application shall be accompanied with process fees of Rs. 5000/- in the form of a demand draft drawn in favor of the “Gujarat Biodiversity Board”.

facts.claim: A written agreement on Rs. 300’s stamp paper is required for access or collection of biological resources and associated knowledge.
facts.subject: application_form_i
facts.evidence: A written agreement (on Rs. 300’s stamp paper) duly signed by an authorized officer of the Board and the applicant shall govern the access or collection, as well as royalty paid to Board.

facts.claim: A company profile in detail with company seal and authorized signature must be attached with Form - I.
facts.subject: application_form_i
facts.evidence: Company profile in detail with company seal and authorized signature.

facts.claim: An address proof of the applicant must be attached with Form - I.
facts.subject: application_form_i

facts.subject: application_form_i

facts.claim: A 3-year audited financial report of the company with a certificate of CA must be attached with Form - I.
facts.subject: application_form_i
facts.evidence: 3 year audited financial report of your company with certificate of CA.

facts.claim: A list of raw material used by the company with scientific names and whether cultivated or wild variety must be attached with Form - I.
facts.subject: application_form_i
facts.evidence: List of Raw Material used by your company with scientific name and Biological Resources/ raw material purchased, whether cultivated or wild variety.

facts.claim: A yearly consumption of raw material must be attached with Form - I.
facts.subject: application_form_i

facts.claim: A list of products manufactured and traded by the company must be attached with Form - I.
facts.subject: application_form_i

facts.claim: A list of suppliers/traders of raw materials and final products in detail must be attached with Form - I.

facts.claim: A person must have one year of experience under a certified electrician or engineer to appear in the wireman examination.
facts.subject: wireman_examination
facts.evidence:
A person
A. Who has worked on wiring and electrical installation works under direct supervision of a competency certificate holder or a qualified electrical engineer for a total period of one year.

facts.claim: A person must have six months of practical experience after completing a wireman apprentice course to appear in the wireman examination.
facts.subject: wireman_examination
facts.evidence: B. Who has gained six months practical experience after completion of the wireman apprentice course at any recognized technical institute and also passed by the examination held by the Technical Examination Board(TEB).

facts.claim: A person must have completed a one-year course in electrician or related fields to appear in the wireman examination.
facts.subject: wireman_examination
facts.evidence: C. Who has completed one year’s course of electrician or radio mechanic or wireman motor rewinding conducted by the director of cottage industries.

facts.claim: A person must have completed a one-year course in electrician at Rajkot to appear in the wireman examination.
facts.subject: wireman_examination
facts.evidence: D. Who has completed one year’s course of electrician conducted by the prototype development and training center at Rajkot.

facts.claim: A person must have completed a six-month course in motor winding to appear in the wireman examination.
facts.subject: wireman_examination
facts.evidence: E. Who has completed six months course of motor winding conducted by TEB.

facts.claim: A person must have passed the wireman examination and have four years of experience to appear in the supervisor examination.
facts.subject: supervisor_examination
facts.evidence:
A person who
A. Have passed the examination of the wireman &
B. have total four years of practical experience under direct supervision of a competency certificate holder or qualified electrical engineer out of which minimum two years’ experience must be gained after passing the wireman examination.

facts.claim: A person must have three and a half years of experience if they have completed an electrician course at a recognized institute to appear in the supervisor examination.
facts.subject: supervisor_examination
facts.evidence:
or
three and half years practical experience, if such candidate has completed electrician course at recognized technical institute and has passed the examination held by TEB, out of which minimum one and half year’s practical experience must be after passing wireman examination.

facts.claim: The supervisor and wireman examinations are conducted twice a year, in May and November.
facts.subject: supervisor_wireman_examination
facts.evidence: The supervisor / wireman exam is conducted by the licensing board twice in a year, one in the month of May and second in the month of November.

facts.claim: Applications for the May supervisor/wireman examination are accepted in February.
facts.subject: supervisor_wireman_examination
facts.evidence: For the examination in May, forms are received by this office in the month of February

facts.claim: Applications for the November supervisor/wireman examination are accepted in August.
facts.subject: supervisor_wireman_examination
facts.evidence: and for the examination in the month of November, the forms are received by this office in the month of August.

facts.claim: To appear in the wireman examination, an application form, two photographs, a Rs.200 challan, an experience certificate (FORM-K), and a copy of the staff register are required.
facts.subject: wireman_examination
facts.evidence:
Which documents are required for appearing in the wireman examination?
Application in the prescribe form, two photographs, a challan of Rs.200/- and experience certificate (FORM-K) from the licensed contractor and a copy of his staff register

facts.claim: To appear in the supervisor examination, an application form, two photographs, a Rs.500 challan, an experience certificate (FORM-K), a copy of the staff register, a wireman certificate, and a permit are required.
facts.subject: supervisor_examination
facts.evidence:
Which document required for appearing in the supervisor examination?
Application in the prescribe form, two photographs, a challan of Rs.500/- and experience certificate (FORM-K) from the licensed contractor and a copy of his staff register, wireman certificate and permit.

facts.claim: A person who has passed the national apprenticeship certificate in electrician, wireman, or lineman trade is exempt from the wireman examination.
facts.subject: wireman_examination
facts.evidence: a person who produces a certificate of having passed the examination for national apprenticeship certificate in electrician, wireman or lineman trade shall be exempted from appearing in the wireman examination.

facts.claim: A person who has passed the national trade certificate in electrician, wireman, or lineman trade is exempt from the wireman examination.
facts.subject: wireman_examination
facts.evidence:
OR
a person who produces a certificate of having passed the examination for national trade certificate in electrician, wireman or lineman trade after completing 2 years training or 18 month training followed by 6 months in plant training shall be exempted from appearing in the wireman examination.

facts.claim: A person who has passed the electrical service technician examination is exempt from the wireman examination.
facts.subject: wireman_examination
facts.evidence:
OR
a person who produces a certificate of having passed the electrical service technician examination shall be exempted from appearing in the wireman examination.

facts.claim: A person who has passed the electrical installation, wiring, and jointing examination held by the Gujarat Technical Examination Board is exempt from the wireman examination.
facts.subject: wireman_examination
facts.evidence:
OR
a person who produces a certificate of having passed the examination of electrical installation, wiring and jointing held by the technical examination board of the Gujarat state shall be exempted from appearing in the wireman examination.

facts.claim: A candidate who has passed the final year’s diploma in electrical engineering is exempt from the supervisor examination.
facts.subject: supervisor_examination
facts.evidence: a candidate who has passed the final year’s examination of the diploma in electrical engineering from technical education board or degree in electrical engineering from university approved by the state government will be exempted from appearing this examination

facts.claim: A candidate who has a degree or diploma in electrical engineering from a recognized institution is exempt from the supervisor examination.
facts.subject: supervisor_examination

detail.certificate_type: degree or diploma in electrical engineering

facts.evidence:
OR
a candidate who possesses a degree or diploma in electrical engineering from a recognized university or institute approved by AICTE or qualification equivalent to such degree or diploma shall be exempted from appearing in this examination.

facts.claim: A candidate who has passed the national apprenticeship certificate in electrician trade and has one year of experience under a supervisor or engineer is exempt from the supervisor examination.
facts.subject: supervisor_examination

detail.certificate_type: national apprenticeship certificate in electrician trade

facts.evidence:
OR
A candidate who produces a certificate of having passed the examination for national apprenticeship certificate in electrician trade and one year practical experience under the direct supervision of a person holding supervisors competency certificate or under a qualified electrical engineer.

facts.claim: A candidate who has passed the electrical service technician examination and has two years of experience under a supervisor or engineer is exempt from the supervisor examination.
facts.subject: supervisor_examination
facts.evidence:
OR
A candidate who produces a certificate of having passed electrical service technician examination conducted by the TEB and who has obtained the exemption from appearing in wireman examination and after obtaining such exemption has obtained two years practical experience under direct supervision of a person holding the supervisors competency certificate or under a qualified electrical engineer.

facts.claim: To obtain an electrical contractor license, a person must have an electrical supervisor permit or employ someone with such a permit.
facts.subject: electrical_contractor_license

detail.requirement: electrical supervisor permit or employ someone with such a permit

facts.evidence: Any person who has electrical supervisor permit or a person who has employed such person can get electrical contractor license.

facts.claim: To obtain an electrical contractor license, an application form, a Rs.5000 challan, a bank solvency of ten thousand, three testing instruments, a partnership deed or memorandum, address proof, and school leaving certificates are required.
facts.subject: electrical_contractor_license

detail.testing_instruments: megger, earth tester, clip on meter

facts.evidence: The document required for the same are (1) application in prescribe form (2) Original Challan of Rs. 5000/- (3)Bank solvency of Ten thousand (4) three Testing instruments namely megger, earth tester, clip on meter, along with purchase bill and a certificate from concerned AEI office. (5) a copy of partnership deed or memorandum and article of association. (6) address proof of the forms (7) school leaving certificate of owner and supervisor.
